dataset_spec.name: uci_retinopathy
dataset_spec.description: UCI Diabetic Retinopathy Debrecen (1151 fundus images from the Messidor set). Image-analysis features: quality and pre-screening flags, microaneurysm counts at six detector confidence levels, exudate measures at eight confidence levels, macula-disc distance, optic-disc diameter and an AM/FM texture classification. Binary presence of retinopathy signs.
dataset_spec.setting: Diabetic retinopathy screening: one colour fundus photograph of an adult with diabetes, analysed by an automatic lesion-detection pipeline. The observations are image-quality and pre-screening flags, the number of candidate microaneurysms found at increasing detector confidence (0.5 to 1.0), normalised exudate measures at increasing confidence, and anatomical descriptors of the macula and optic disc.
